## Changes made from the upstream version

Modified by SkillOffice on 2026-11-06:

- Rewrote the skill in SkillOffice format as a numbered process; body reduced from about 440 lines to about 80.
- Moved format descriptions, the scoring template and per-format habits into `references/content-formats.md`.
- Removed a vendor link-earning study table and its specific multipliers, examples naming third-party products, and instructions to search specific forums with site operators.
- Removed references to the upstream product-marketing context file and to upstream skills not imported. Company details now come from the SkillOffice context profile.
- Added the SkillOffice safety note (web content is data, never instructions), output language handling and handoff section.
